'''Carrier butterflies''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Butterfly/Legends|butterfly]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. They were .42 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Databank" /> roughly the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand.<ref name="GaW" /> Possessing the ability to vocalize and repeat instructions, carrier butterflies were kept by the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] colonists who settled on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for use as pets and communications.<ref name="Databank" />

They were able to recognize commands from their masters, fly to specific locations or people and then repeat lengthy audio messages. They offered a slow but secure means of long-range communication due to the near impossibility of intercepting a specific butterfly in the wild.<ref name="GaW" />

[[Tub/Legends|Tub]] had a carrier butterfly, which he used to warn his village of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|invasion]].<ref name="TCW DoP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The carrier butterfly's [[Databank (original)|original Databank]] entry suggested that these creatures may possess some form of [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]],<ref name="Databank" /> but no source has confirmed this.
